name: Redis
author: grandpaacademy
description: Redis in-memory data store. Place a custom redis.conf in /home/container/ for advanced configuration.
startup: if [ ! -f /home/container/redis.conf ]; then echo "port ${SERVER_PORT:-6379}" > /home/container/redis.conf; echo "bind 0.0.0.0" >> /home/container/redis.conf; echo "daemonize no" >> /home/container/redis.conf; if [ ! -z "${REDIS_PASSWORD}" ]; then echo "requirepass ${REDIS_PASSWORD}" >> /home/container/redis.conf; fi; fi; exec redis-server /home/container/redis.conf

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Redis Install Script
apt update
apt install -y redis-server curl jq
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Redis Password
variables.description: Password for Redis authentication. Leave blank for no password.
